product.title: Adaptis Sneakers For Men : Beige
product.description:
Stopping mid-walk to tie your laces because they’ve come undone again reads like a familiar problem, right? The Adaptis Sneakers were designed exactly to fix this. A turn-dial system tightens the shoe exactly where you need it, and exactly how much you need it. No laces to bother with; just lift the dial, turn, and push it in, and it fits exactly how you want it.

  • Closure Type: Lace-up
  • Shoe Size Width: Wide

  • Arch Type: Low Arch
  • Water-Resistant: No
  • Shoe Height: Low-Top
